saw_lines: People buy loungewear for one feeling, comfy at home, then reorder the same cut when the first pair wears out.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the buyer decides if the mood fits.
Your site shows 500,000+ orders shipped and 2624 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry either number. Put 2624 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 500,000+ orders shipped and 2624 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry either number, so cold buyers see no proof number. Put the 2624 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 10% off your first order when you subscribe, yet 0 of 16 ads mention it, so new buyers get no reason to act. Put that offer in the opening line of three new ads and on the creative.

9 of your 16 ads open on “you’re about to make a cool decision”, so the same hook keeps reaching the same people. Name two or three angles, like fluffy pjoys and winter hoodies, and test each against that hook.

Your site runs a subscribe and save offer, yet 0 of 30 ads mention a subscription. Repeat buyers never hear about the saving. Run two retention ads for past buyers with the subscription saving as the headline.

ads_1: Fresh hook angles for pjoys and winter hoodies, tested against the current opener
